# Weekly Pow Wash income, spending and profit chart data

Please create a clean weekly line chart from the CSV below.

Use `week_start` on the X axis.

Plot these three lines:
- `income_ex_vat_by_booking_date` as Income
- `spending_ex_vat_by_expense_date` as Spending
- `profit_ex_vat` as Profit

Important interpretation notes:
- Income is grouped by the calendar/job booking date when the invoice reference contains a `GC-YYYYMMDD` booking date.
- If no calendar reference exists, income falls back to the Xero invoice issue date. The fallback count is included so uncertain older weeks can be spotted.
- Spending is grouped by the Xero supplier bill or spend-money expense date.
- Values are ex VAT. That is the best view for income/profit because VAT is not business profit.
- Do not treat this as a formal accountant P&L. It is a charting view from Xero invoices, bills and spend-money expenses.

Recommended chart styling:
- Income: green
- Spending: red/orange
- Profit: blue
- Use weekly ticks or monthly labels on the X axis so it remains readable.
- If possible, lightly mark weeks where `income_from_invoice_date_fallback_count` is high, because those weeks are less calendar-accurate.
